_comment: Evaluation set for Bhunaga. Every question is the SAME question in en/hi/mr, so cross-language consistency is measurable: the three should retrieve the same document and give the same figures. Every item is answerable from a real file in data/, and expected_source names it, so source_match is meaningful rather than always zero. answer_keywords list the facts a correct answer must contain, with the en/hi/mr spellings of each, because grading has to work across scripts. The last four items target the native-language documents specifically, which is where SAME_LANG_BOOST has something to do.
